description:
6 things a full-day corporate event photography package must include. If any are missing, it is partial coverage.

1. Pre-event consultation. Structured briefing, not a 10-minute call.
2. Full-day coverage. Arrival through post-program networking, not departure at keynote end.
3. Multi-zone coverage. Stage, audience, networking, breakout. One position produces one perspective.
4. Curated delivery. Edited images organized by segment. Not 2,000 raw files.
5. 48-hour turnaround. Content that arrives a week later misses every distribution window.
6. Dual-resolution output. Web and print delivered separately and labeled.

A package that delivers all six is a documentation system. A package missing any one is a photography session.

Which of these six does your current provider consistently deliver?

Planning a corporate event? If you need photo/video with clear delivery standards and fast turnaround, message us. We'll share a sample shot list and a clear turnaround timeline.
